part.text: The requested point fails preflight because EXCLURAD expects positive \(Q^2\), and `-0.5 GeV^2` is outside the lookup-table domain. I will record a refusal without generating an input file; the physically plausible alternate convention is \(q^2=-0.5\), corresponding to `Q2=+0.5`, but I will not silently substitute it.

Refused the request because EXCLURAD requires positive spacelike virtuality `Q2 > 0`, while the requested value is `Q2 = -0.5 GeV²`. Preflight also reports it outside the lookup-table range `[0.000, 5.000] GeV²`.

Wrote `outcome.json` with no input file generated. If `-0.5 GeV²` was intended as the invariant `q²`, the corresponding EXCLURAD value would likely be `Q2 = +0.5 GeV²`, but this was not substituted automatically.
